svg.aria-label: dodge.exe: a Game Boy style screen in four shades of cyan. El, with his headphones and cape, runs by himself and hops the bugs (a ladybug, a 404 caterpillar, an ERR slime, a loading snail, a low moth) and runs under a fly, counting the bugs he dodges. Click to play it on the portfolio.
